title: GRPO-Registry record
description: A machine-readable catalog record for a group-relative RL (GRPO-family) training stack, or for a variant-delta (the set of changes a named GRPO variant makes to the base algorithm). Field convention: JSON null means UNREPORTED; explicit false / 0.0 / 'none' means reported-as-absent. The MIN-REPORT auditor scores reporting coverage, not configuration virtue.

label_claimed.description: The algorithm label the stack advertises (grpo, dapo, drgrpo, gspo, ...). The registry exists because this label underdetermines the update rule.

variant_deltas_applied.description: Per-delta implementation status against the named variant-delta records. This is where label flips become machine-readable.

delta_id.description: Must point to a registry/entries/delta_*.json record. Enum is regenerated by scripts/p5p8/regenerate_schema_delta_enum.py whenever a delta is added.

outcomes.description: Optional telemetry summary (informational; not part of the badge).

coverage.description: Iter-62: self-reported coverage of the entry's reporting blocks. All fields nullable; null = not yet audited. min_report_coverage is the fraction of7 MIN-REPORT items with at least one sub-field populated. declared_deltas_coverage is the fraction of variant_deltas_applied entries with status in {implemented, surrogate}. measured_coverage is variant: measured_rows / delta_components, or stack: outcomes_fields_populated / 5. ci_method_present mirrors outcomes.ci_method being non-null. audit_source is the script path that produced the block. Versioned metrics below supersede ambiguous legacy names for newly generated entries; reporting completeness is independent of implementation presence.

min_report_item_presence_v1.description: Fraction of seven MIN-REPORT items with at least one reported leaf; false and zero count as reported.

min_report_leaf_mean_v2.description: Equal-weight mean of each MIN-REPORT item reported-leaf fraction (badge/100 before badge rounding).

declared_delta_reporting_completeness_v2.description: Fraction of declared delta rows whose status is implemented, surrogate or absent. Unknown is unreported. Null when no rows exist.

declared_delta_implementation_fraction_v.description: Fraction of declared delta rows with status implemented, excluding surrogate and absent. Null when no rows exist.

declared_delta_surrogate_fraction_v1.description: Fraction of declared delta rows with status surrogate. Null when no rows exist.

item_presence_coverage_v3.description: Fraction of seven items with at least one reported substantive schema leaf; source/description excluded.

reported_leaf_coverage_v3.description: Equal-weight mean of seven schema-defined substantive leaf fractions; explicit disabled clipping makes epsilons inapplicable.

zvf_antiherding.description: Iter-66: Contrastive Yield (Y = 1 - ZVF) + anti-herding residual delta_div = ZVF_iid - ZVF_obs (frontier synthesis: Gemini Deep Think Round 2), measured on the N2 same-stack reward tensor corpus. All fields nullable. Y is the fraction of groups GRPO can still assign within-group credit to; delta_div >= 0 if sampling anti-herds. ci_method.source is the audit script that produced the block.

controller_predicted_savings_per_rollout.description: Iter-70: per-(method × trigger × threshold) controller savings predictions for the iter-51 adaptive-G controller on this stack. All fields nullable; null = not yet audited. Sourced from iter-67 p7_antiherding_controller_cf_summary.tsv.

predictions.description: Per-(trigger, threshold) controller prediction. Each element: trigger (str), threshold (num), fires/saved/missed (int), saved_per_fire (num), savings_per_rollout_pt/lo/hi (num, bootstrap percentile), cost_ratio_pt (num). Source: iter-67 p7_antiherding_controller_cf_summary.tsv.

n_mismatch_audit.description: Optional count of mismatches found by a record-specific provenance audit.

run_config.description: Generated by registry/generate_entries.py from the actual run sources. Keys are the stackdiff FIELDS catalogue in registry/query.py; each value carries its provenance. Overrides the hand-entered top-level/min_report view in stackdiff.

effective_manifest.description: Typed supported observations; other runtime telemetry is permitted but is not promoted into catalogue evidence.

token_aggregation.description: Iter-32 extension: aggregation level for the token-level loss; "token" for DAPO, "sequence" for GSPO.

reward_shaping_type.description: Iter-32 extension: type of reward shaping (e.g. overlong_penalty for DAPO, gamma_baseline for GIFT).

sampling_dynamic_filter.description: Iter-32 extension: whether the sampler applies dynamic filtering (e.g. DAPO dynamic_sampling).

clipping_applied.description: False explicitly disables ratio clipping; epsilon fields are then inapplicable

heldout_split.description: Item 6: held-out split disjoint from the reward environment.

n.description: Number of saved held-out example identifiers; null when unverified

id.description: Same pattern as the stack_record; the schema was missing this check on the variant-delta side (iter 26 stress test).

measured.description: Iter-34 extension (additive, optional): measured effect of this variant vs its base on a named, provenanced panel. Each element is a single (metric x panel) delta with a bootstrap/normal-approx CI. null / absent = unmeasured. This is the first block that grounds a variant_delta record in what the technique measurably does, not just what it claims to change.

expected_effects.description: Iter-46 extension (additive, optional): a forward-referenced per-(metric, panel) tuple of {predicted_sign, rationale} that the human-readable change text implies. Entries without this block are still audited -- the audit verdict is UNCLAIMED for the (metric, panel) pairs that lack a declared prediction. This block is the human-supplied input; the audit's claim_validation block (below) is the matching machine-generated output.

claim_validation.description: Iter-46 extension (additive, optional): machine-generated audit of the (measured, expected) pair per (metric, panel). Each element is a single (metric x panel) verdict: SUPPORTS / NEUTRAL / CONTRADICTS / UNCLAIMED, with the matching CI and a one-line rationale. This is the machine output that grounds a registry entry in 'what the change text claims' AND 'what was measured'.

measured_yield_residual.description: Iter-66: Contrastive-Yield residual (frontier synthesis: Gemini Deep Think Round 2) for this variant vs its declared base. delta_div_delta = (delta_div in variant) - (delta_div in base); negative means the variant reduces the structural diversity bonus, i.e. its sampling policy herds more than GRPO's. y_obs_delta is the same comparison on the Contrastive Yield axis (positive = more within-group credit available). All fields nullable; null = not yet audited.

controller_predicted_savings_per_rollout.description: Iter-70: per-(trigger × threshold) controller savings predictions for the variant on the N2 same-stack corpus. Inherits from the variant's measured method; predictions carry the iter-67 saved_per_fire and savings_per_rollout paired-bootstrap estimates.

predictions.description: Per-(trigger, threshold) controller prediction. Each element: trigger (str), threshold (num), fires/saved/missed (int), saved_per_fire (num), savings_per_rollout_pt/lo/hi (num, bootstrap percentile), cost_ratio_pt (num). Source: iter-67 p7_antiherding_controller_cf_summary.tsv.

joint_controller.description: Iter-76 (P5P8 SYNTH / JOB B): cost-adjusted joint-controller predictions per method x tau (extension of iter-70 row 82 block; pairs with iter-72 row 85 joint_controller.py outputs).

metric.description: Measured quantity, e.g. zvf, reward_mean, zvf_risk_mean, mean_zvf.

panel.description: The measurement panel, e.g. n2_same_stack_last10 or zvf130_5seed.

base.description: Base stack the delta is computed against (must match the record's `base`).

delta.description: variant minus base (signed). Null = unmeasured (backfilled point, see synth_from_agg).

significant.description: True iff the CI excludes 0; null = CI is degenerate (point estimate, see synth_from_agg).

source.description: Relative path to the artifact the delta was computed from.

window_sensitivity.description: iter-84: window-sensitivity verdict of this (metric, panel) row under remeasurement on full40 / last10 / last5 (paired bootstrap B=2000, seed 20260705); see docs/p5p8_improvements/97_p6_n2_window_sensitivity.md.

robust_panel.description: iter-84: largest-window panel at which the same-sign significance holds; 'none' if no panel is significant.

sig_robust_bootstrap_and_welch.description: iter102: significance survives BOTH the paired Gaussian-residual bootstrap AND a conservative Welch two-sample t-test on the 5-seed risk index. Guards against optimistic single-method significance.

synth_from_agg.description: iter-122: True if this row was synthesized from an aggregate (point) statistic rather than per-seed data; CI is then not meaningful. Set by scripts/p5p8/p6_iter118_zvf130_deltas_backfill.py when backfilling from mag_mean / mean_zvf aggregates whose per-seed sd was not stored.

expected_effect.description: Iter-46: human-supplied forward reference -- the predicted sign the change text implies for one (metric, panel) pair. The audit's claim_validation row for the same (metric, panel) either supports, is neutral, or contradicts this prediction.

predicted_sign.description: Operator string: '>0' = measured delta should be positive, '<0' = negative, '>=0' / '<=0' allow the boundary, '=0' = exact zero expected.

rationale.description: One-sentence justification of the predicted sign, citing the change text's clause.

claim_validation_row.description: Iter-46: machine-generated audit row matching one (metric, panel) measured entry against the declared expected_effect (if any).

audit_source.description: iter-122: audit-script path that produced this row, e.g. 'scripts/p5p8/p6_iter118_zvf130_deltas_backfill.py'. Optional; absent for human-written entries.

audit_date.description: iter-122: ISO date the audit script produced this row, e.g. '2026-07-05'. Optional.

synth_from_agg.description: iter-122: True if this row was synthesized from an aggregate (point) statistic rather than per-seed data. CI is then not meaningful. Set true by scripts/p5p8/p6_iter118_zvf130_deltas_backfill.py when it backfills a measured row from mag_mean / mean_zvf aggregates whose per-seed sd was not stored.

notes.description: Optional machine-generation or backfill note for this validation row.

ci_method.description: Optional self-reported provenance of the confidence interval on this entry's outcomes/deltas (added iter 28, backward-compatible optional field). null = unreported.

run_config_cell.description: One derived run field with provenance. logged means observed artifact; code means extracted pinned implementation; default requires resolved runtime evidence, never an absent launch command; inferred requires a stated supported rule; unknown requires value=null.
